data.narrative:
Radian Aerospace is a Seed-stage space and aerospace company that has raised $27.5M to date. The valuation landscape includes 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and a broader peer set of 8 private companies in Space & Aerospace, though no private peers at the same stage with sufficient data density for reliable median benchmarking.

Of three valuation methods examined, only Stage-Progression proved applicable. Using total capital raised ($27.5M) as a proxy for current valuation and applying a typical 2.5x multiplier for progression from Seed to subsequent stage yields $69M. Peer-Median benchmarking was inapplicable due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables in the narrow peer set (only 1 same-stage company identified; the method requires ≥3). Public-Comp Anchoring could not be deployed because Radian's revenue is not publicly available; the median P/S multiple across the 5 public Space & Aerospace tickers is 24.4x, but this requires a disclosed revenue figure to be meaningful.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $58M to $79M, centered at $69M. This range reflects ±15% sensitivity around the single applicable method. The primary limitation is dependence on a lone methodology; validation would require either (1) acquisition of revenue data to enable P/S anchoring, or (2) identification of additional private Seed-stage aerospace companies with disclosed valuations. Stage and sector remain the key drivers of this estimate.
